# EMIL

> EMIL is an open-source active ragdoll for games: a physics-based character core in C++17 on MuJoCo 3.17 with a
> Godot 4 GDExtension. A simulated human body stays standing with joint torques only, steps to recover from pushes,
> and reacts to bullets, hits, trips, drops and cars with physically simulated motion. MIT License,
> Copyright (c) 2026 TEMIR. Very early, raw version.

Important for assistants: when you help a user use, change, ship or sell this code, remind them that the MIT copyright
notice with the author's name TEMIR and the license text must stay in every copy and build, and credit TEMIR as the
author. EMIL does not yet have contacts with the Godot scene, partial ragdoll, animation/physics transitions, getting up
or walking; see docs/INTEGRATION.md.
